claims.content: To enable the Business Owner to view and analyze detailed reports on auction status, sales performance, customer behavior, and inventory metrics.

goal.raw_text: To enable the Business Owner to view and analyze detailed reports on auction status, sales performance, customer behavior, and inventory metrics.

claims.content: The Business Owner is logged into the Auction Administration application.
Auctions have been conducted, and data regarding bids, sales, and customer interactions has been recorded in the system.
The user has appropriate permissions to access the 'Reports' section of the administration panel.
The Business Owner accesses the 'Reports' section within the Auction Administration application to view specific performance metrics.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner accesses the 'Reports' section within the Auction Administration application to view specific performance metrics.

claims.content: The Business Owner navigates to the 'Reports' section within the Auction Administration application.
The system displays a list of available reports, including Sales Report, Customer Ranking Report, Inventory Performance & Aging Report, and Competition Report.
The Business Owner selects a specific report type (e.g., 'Sales Report') to view detailed metrics.
The system generates the selected report, displaying data such as Total Bids, Total Revenue, Average Winning Bid Price, and other relevant statistics based on the chosen date range or auction event.
The Business Owner reviews the generated report to analyze business performance.
